name: exchange rates
commands:
f=~/.config/omarchy-proot/exchange-rates
mkdir -p "${f%/*}"
[ -f "$f" ] || printf 'USD\nEUR\nGBP\nJPY\n' > "$f"
codes=$(grep -v '^#' "$f" | grep . | tr a-z A-Z)
base=$(head -n1 <<< "$codes")
to=$(tail -n +2 <<< "$codes" | paste -sd, -)
curl -fsLm 10 "https://api.frankfurter.dev/v1/$(date -d '30 days ago' +%F)..?base=$base&symbols=$to" | jq -c --arg to "$to" '
  (.rates | to_entries | sort_by(.key) | map(.value)) as $days | $days[-1] as $now | $days[-2] as $prev |
  {base, rates: [$to | split(",")[] | select($now[.]) | {code: ., rate: $now[.], change: (($now[.] / $prev[.] - 1) * 100), hist: [$days[][.]]}]}'
